[[File:Exciting Victory Pokémon Card Game.png|thumb|Exciting Victory! Pokémon Card Game!!]] (Japanese: '''激勝！ポケモンカードゲーム！！''' ''Exciting Victory! Pokémon Card Game!!'') is a [[Pokémon manga]]. It was published in ''Dengeki Nintendo DS'' (デンゲキニンテンドーDS) 2010, 2011 and 2012. It was illustrated by [[Tamori wa Taru]] (タモリはタル) under the name Tanaka Udon (たなかうどん). {{stub|Manga}}
